title: Kimi K3.1 Pro extends Moonshot's agent model to 1M-token context
dek: Moonshot's new 3T-class model emphasizes long-horizon coding and financial research with a faster serving tier.
evidence: Moonshot model and product descriptions; benchmark and throughput claims vendor-reported
takeaway: Evaluate effective long-context retrieval and cost per completed task, not nominal context length.

sections.title: Context

bullets.detail: A model accepting a million tokens says nothing about whether it can retrieve the right evidence or complete a lengthy workflow economically.

paragraphs: Long-context marketing can mislead: A model accepting a million tokens says nothing about whether it can retrieve the right evidence or complete a lengthy workflow economically.

sections.title: What's new

bullets.detail: Moonshot released a 3T-class flagship model in Kimi Code with an advertised maximum context window of roughly 1.05M tokens for eligible tiers; its model requires thinking mode.
A separate tier claims 2–3× faster model output with similar capabilities, typically at about twice the quota usage.

paragraphs: K3.1 Pro rollout: Moonshot released a 3T-class flagship model in Kimi Code with an advertised maximum context window of roughly 1.05M tokens for eligible tiers; its model requires thinking mode.
Highspeed option: A separate tier claims 2–3× faster model output with similar capabilities, typically at about twice the quota usage.

sections.title: Evidence & limitations

bullets.detail: The context, mode restrictions and Highspeed throughput are provider documentation, not independently measured task-completion benchmarks.
File reads, tool calls, cache misses and compaction can dominate latency even if tokens stream faster.

paragraphs: Product specifications: The context, mode restrictions and Highspeed throughput are provider documentation, not independently measured task-completion benchmarks.
Throughput isn't end-to-end speed: File reads, tool calls, cache misses and compaction can dominate latency even if tokens stream faster.

sections.title: Why it matters

bullets.detail: Use known facts at the beginning, middle and end of huge documents; score exact citation retrieval, contradictions and cross-section synthesis.
A bigger context can increase prefill/caching cost. Compare completed coding tasks, error recovery and time per result across tiers.
